content:
**The Freak Show** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia. It is located a short distance east from Huntersville.

The Freak Show was effectively a zoo for Raiders to display some of the more horrible mutated monstrosities encountered in the wasteland - for a fee, of course.

This former Raider camp is situated beneath a cliff, stretching alongside Route 107. The southern end has the ticket booth with a Safe, a Caps Stash, and a roll of tickets in an old truck, while the cages further inside contain numerous dead mutants. The bowling section includes a pair of dead Radstags. The location has several traps, including a Flamethrower, Bone Chimes, and several mines. A bicycle made from a human skeleton can be found at this location.

The Freak Show appears in *Fallout 76*.
